snippet.title: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM | Zucchero Café Preview Video
snippet.description:
Time-Limited Event [Zucchero Café] will be open from 2/27.
During the event, Commanders can receive generous rewards including [Collapse Pieces], [Access Permissions], [Targeted Access Permissions] by clearing event stages and participating in the event Game mode.

[Duration] 
2025/2/27 09:00 ~ 2025/3/19 18:59(GMT+0)
The event shop exchange will expire at 2025/3/26 18:59(GMT+0)

[Unlock Conditions] 
Commander Level 20
